tasks.title: Run go vet and static scanners
tasks.detail: README says govulncheck and gosec were never run. Run go vet ./..., govulncheck ./... and gosec ./... (install tools outside the repo; no dependency added), record findings. Fix only trivial findings; file tasks for the rest. Update README Verification status line if scanners now run.

criteria.text: Scanner results are summarised in the task summary, with each finding fixed or queued as a task

tasks.title: Check the test-count claim in README Verification status
tasks.detail: README.md says 127 unit and end-to-end tests pass (0.6.0). Count the actual tests with go test -v ./... and correct the number in README.md and docs/reference if it differs.

criteria.text: The number in README.md equals the count of PASSing top-level tests from go test -v ./...
